description: Developed and maintained the backend of a logistics platform, implementing an authentication system, CRUD operations, and a set of REST APIs. Created and continuously updated technical API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI for both internal developers and external consumers. To ensure backend quality and stability, implemented and maintained comprehensive testing using Jest. As part of a 5-person Agile team, actively contributed to integrating the React-based frontend with the Node.js backend. Gained hands-on experience in deployment processes while learning production environment best practices. Under the guidance of a senior developer, also participated in conducting code reviews and task planning during sprints, which helped maintain high code standards and efficient team workflow.
